routeAdjustment: Reuse the exact original torsion representative and principal-class criterion. Adapt only the short native Kummer fixed-field/root-of-unity argument to derive the literal splitting-field witness. The external nondegeneracy theorem requires Picard divisibility on auxiliary covers, which the original modular-curve Abel comparison does not supply. A direct analytic Weil/period comparison is also absent. Defer wholesale generic-curve or higher-level infrastructure until that exact remaining cover/analytic route is assessed; this entry witness is necessary for the checked Kummer proof and introduces no divisibility or nondegeneracy premise.
discharged: Every nonzero actual original Picard n-torsion class yields a degree-zero representative and nonzero principal function with orders n times that divisor, and the function is not an n-th power. Its literal polynomial splitting field contains a root moved by an actual automorphism through a constant unequal to one.
